newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Volatility to head down next week.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Volatility to head down next week.

text.p: Implied volatility of debt options on LIFFE will drop in the coming week, regardless of U.S. data to be released on Friday, derivatives analysts said.
"We could get a spike up or down this afternoon, but volatility will come lower in the next few days," said Ian Aubrey, head of futures and options sales at Yamaichi International in London.
"A lot of volatility is quite low already, but that doesn't mean it couldn't go lower," he added.
Brokers quoted April Bund option volatility at around 5.9 percent, in line with Thursday's close.

U.S. February producer price data, due at 1330 GMT, is forecast to fall 0.1 percent compared with a 0.3 percent fall in January. February industrial production is forecast to rise 0.5 percent while capacity utilisation is forecast at 83.5 percent. These data are due for release at 1415 GMT.
Volatility has moved higher in the run-up to Friday's data, and U.S. contracts will lead the downward trend in volatility, options players said.
But Friday's data has had less impact on volatility than last week's employment figures, they added.

"If the figures are strong this afternoon then obviously volatility levels will be increased. Treasuries will be dragged down and that'll have a similar effect on Bunds," said a broker at a Japanese Bank in London.
"But on any push up we will see volatility gradually start to decline, especially with the overly increased puts exposure, people will be more inclined to sell those out."
He said for this session, trading had been mixed in terms of price action.
"On the whole the inclination has been more towards selling puts," the broker said.

Volume was light on LIFFE ahead of the data release. In Bunds, activity focused on April calls at 101.50 and 102.00 and June calls at 102.00. Bund puts were traded in reasonable number at the April 101.00 strikes, May 99.00 and 100.00 and June 100.50 and 101.00.
At 1305 GMT, the underlying June Bund future was at 101.29, down 13 basis points on the day.
